name: Ideogram
desc: Best-in-class legible text rendering inside images
desc_zh: 图像内文字排版准确率领先，是海报与 Logo 生成的常用选择
solves: Image models mangle the text inside pictures. It renders readable headlines and logos, so you can use it for posters.
solves_zh: 图像模型常把图里的字渲染得认不出来。它能把标题和 Logo 排清楚，所以海报也能用。
best_for: When the words in the image matter as much as the picture itself.
best_for_zh: 图里的文字和画面本身一样重要的时候。
